title: P2a: executor economics in the scorecard — per executor and per complexity band or task class: initial execution tokens, first-pass green rate, fix-round probability, average fix rounds, tokens and cost to accepted task, gate failure reasons, review request_changes rate; optional cost-to-accepted ranking behind pool.toml [models].rank_by (default unchanged); CLI scorecard --economics
spec:
Phase I P2 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, section P2: evaluate executors on cost per accepted task, measure, do not hard-code). Base goal/T-0445 with P0 merged (attribution fields, stamps first_green_at, gate_attempts, gate_reds, lineage_fix_rounds, accepted_at; scorecard.efficiency and _attributed for legacy rows; H7 pipeline.failure_kind and resume_hint.failures exist from Phase H). Do not touch spawn.py, daemon.py or executor.py (P1b and P1c own spawn.py in parallel).
1. scorecard.executor_economics(root=STATE, by="executor") -> dict keyed by executor id (by="executor"), or by (executor, band) / (executor, class) for by in ("band", "class"): for the accepted and failed execute lineage roots attributed to that executor: n_tasks, initial_execution_tokens (median, mean: bucket execute rows of the root only), first_pass_green_rate with defined count (P0 definition), fix_round_probability (share of roots with fix_rounds >= 1), avg_fix_rounds, tokens_to_accepted (median over accepted roots: the P0 per-task total), cost_to_accepted (median usd), gate_failure_reasons (histogram over the lineage's gate_red events: pipeline.failure_kind when present, else a classifier over resume_hint.failures head: missing_tests, test_failure, lint, environment, unknown), review_request_changes_rate (review tasks whose inputs[0] lies in the lineage: request_changes / all verdicts, defined count). Rows read through _attributed so history counts. None for undefined values (H1 rule).
2. Ranking input, no default change: scorecard.scores(card, min_runs=5, rank_by=None): rank_by None or "success" keeps today's merged/(merged+failed) with bench priors; rank_by "cost_to_accepted" returns a score inversely proportional to the executor's median cost_to_accepted when it has >= [models].min_samples accepted roots, else falls back to the success score. pool.toml [models] gets rank_by = "success" with a comment explaining the alternative and that P4 evidence decides a switch; executor.start passes pool.cfg["models"].get("rank_by") through unchanged wiring (pool.py reads cfg, no new import path).
3. CLI: orchestrator scorecard --economics [--by executor|band|class] [--json]: table with the fields above, n/a for None.
Tests tests/test_scorecard.py: test_executor_economics_first_pass_and_fix_round_probability, test_executor_economics_tokens_and_cost_to_accepted_median, test_executor_economics_gate_failure_reasons_histogram, test_executor_economics_review_request_changes_rate, test_executor_economics_by_band_and_class, test_scores_rank_by_cost_to_accepted_falls_back_below_min_samples, test_scores_default_rank_unchanged; tests/test_cli.py::test_cli_scorecard_economics_text_and_json. Existing tests green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; commit with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: pool.toml [models].rank_by = "success" documented; default routing scores are byte-identical to before for the same inputs
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
